The existing established neighborhoods and their forecasted composition will remain as planned under the recommended alignment, since the highway will remain in its present location.
There are two High school Districts within the area of this improvement, these Districts are No. 227 and No. 206. Neither of the two High School Districts, No. 227 and No. 206, will be adversely affected by the improvement as all students required to cross the highway are presently bussed.
Elementary School Districts No. 159, No. 162, and No. 170 also are involved in this project. District No. 159 at present has no schools within the area and there is no indication that future students in the undeveloped areas east of Cicero Avenue and south of Lincoln Highway would have to walk across the roadway.
District No. 162 includes Oakwood School, Arcadia Elementary School, Matteson Elementary School, Matteson Upper-Grade School, Illinois Grade School and Indiana Grade School. Of these, the Matteson Upper-Grade School is the only Junior High School. Each of the elementary schools serves a neighborhood and all children crossing Lincoln Highway are presently bussed as are those who attend the Junior High School.
School District No. 170 on the eastern end of this project is in the City of Chicago Heights and has Kennedy, Wilson, Roosevelt, and McKinley Elementary Schools and Washington Junior High School. Of these neighborhood elementary schools only Roosevelt has children crossing Lincoln Highway. The Roosevelt School neighborhood spans Lincoln Highway. The children presently are provided with an underpass at the school property. The design of the proposed improvement eliminates the underpass and includes a pedestrian overpass at this location to provide higher service and safety standards for the school children. The pedestrian overpass offers advantages over the underpass in lighting, drainage, litter removal, vandalism and crime prevention.
Parochial schools in the area are St. Paul's Lutheran, Zion Lutheran, St. Lawrence O'Toole Catholic and St. Agnes. St. Paul's Lutheran School has some students who cross Lincoln Highway on foot at Ashland Avenue. Zion Lutheran in Matteson does not have any students at the present time who are crossing Lincoln Highway. St. Lawrence O'Toole, also in Matteson, has only one family on Wingate Road which has to cross Lincoln Highway. Other students from the north side of the highway are presently bussed to school.
